newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end lower,market focus on stx options.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end lower,market focus on stx options.

text.p: Tokyo stocks finished lower on Friday as market participants squared positions ahead of the three-day weekend, brokers said. Trade was thin, they said, as investors went to the sidelines to watch the launch of individual stock options trading.
The Nikkei 225 shed 269.93 points or 1.32 percent to 20,249.32. Its September futures fell 270 points to 20,280.
"The market was preoccupied with the start of stock options, whittling down trade below the 500 million shares traded on Thursday," Tadahiro Kamogawa, Yamaichi Securities general manager, said.
"The handful of issues propping up the market lately have risen quite far and the market is ready for a breather," he added.
